candidate_futility.minimum_context: at least two distinct day clusters and two venues; never a race-count-only decision
candidate_futility.conditions: All day/venue cluster means worse on paired Winner rank AND actual Top3 mean rank; role capture total nonpositive in each cluster; adverse races outnumber favorable races; observed missingness strata show no reversal. Missing evidence => HOLD.
candidate_futility.missingness_strata: fully neutral sub-index present vs absent, frozen only; no retrospective zero-weight reranking
candidate_futility.action: May close Candidate window before 30 after explicit human reject/simplify decision; other measurement programs continue; no automatic promotion
candidate_futility.reason: Persistent direction across independent contexts and multiple prediction dimensions is a futility warning, not statistical proof.
